theorems.name: Submission.ind_mass_density_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Tj : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) n), (⨆ j, (Tj j).mass) < ∞ → ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)), ∃ C r₀ : ℝ, 0 < r₀ ∧ ∀ r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) r₀, ∀ᶠ j in atTop, (Tj (φ j)).massOn (ball x r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * r ^ n)
